# Feature Definition-of-Done Checklist

Copy per feature/PR.

- [ ] Traces to a requirement / user story (ID: ___)
- [ ] Input validated server-side with a shared schema
- [ ] Authorisation (role + ownership) enforced on the server
- [ ] DB constraints protect the invariants
- [ ] Loading, empty, error, success states implemented
- [ ] Responsive at 390 / 768 / 1440 (screenshots looked at)
- [ ] Keyboard accessible, labelled, contrast OK
- [ ] Reduced motion respected (if animated)
- [ ] No secrets, no console errors, no TODOs in the demo path
- [ ] Typecheck, lint, tests, build pass
- [ ] Flow exercised end-to-end (how: ___)
- [ ] Committed with a clear message
